name: Pointer-array GEMM interface
summary: Execute same-shaped GEMMs using device arrays of per-problem operand pointers.

strategy.intent: Turn a composed GEMM kernel into a safe, reusable host-callable operation.
strategy.mechanism: Execute same-shaped GEMMs using device arrays of per-problem operand pointers.
strategy.expected_benefit: Provides uniform validation, resource management, launch, and workload-mode integration.
tradeoffs: Device wrappers add host-side policy and workspace requirements that must remain consistent with the selected kernel.

constraints.expression: pointer arrays contain batch_count valid device pointers
constraints.rationale: Required for a valid and correctly ordered device execution.

references.evidence: The referenced CUTLASS device API implements this integration method.
